prompts.oxblood: Use case: style-transfer. Create the OXBLOOD theme version of the Skald portrait in image 1. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and must preserve the exact weathered ordinary middle-aged musician, receding tousled hair, lined broad face, large nose, amused sideways glance, rustic wool mantle, scarf, pose and lute. Image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE: the existing Oxblood healer from this game's skill-tree artwork. Restyle the musician to match the Oxblood reference: flat opaque rough gouache paint, dry ragged brush edges, deep oxblood burgundy shadows, muted bone and parchment highlights, restrained charcoal, reduced two/three-tone palette. Keep him scruffy and lived-in, never handsome, polished, youthful or heroic. Waist-up musician holding ONLY his lute, no weapons or shields. Match the reference's strong readable silhouette with negative space. The lute may have subtle ghostly ivory strings, but no floating musical-note symbols, no orbiting ribbons, no neon or bloom. No background, real transparent alpha. No text or borders. Square canvas, entire head, hands and instrument visible with breathing room, artistically ragged lower cutout edge. The final asset must belong beside the existing Oxblood portraits, not look like a photograph, 3D render or smooth digital painting.
prompts.nordic: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the NORDIC theme skill-tree backdrop for Skald, showing JUST THE LUTE, absolutely no character, hands, face, body, clothing, other props or scenery. Image 1 is the existing Nordic mage STAFF, used only as STYLE/COMPOSITION REFERENCE, do not depict a staff. Image 2 supplies the lute's recognizable pear-shaped body, delicate strings, round carved soundhole, short neck and curved scroll. Depict one full standalone Nordic spectral lute, diagonally oriented from lower left (body) to upper right (neck/scroll), strong elegant object silhouette. Match the Nordic reference's opaque hand-painted gouache brush texture and carved natural details: weathered grey-brown wood, muted bronze Nordic knotwork, bone-colored soundboard, grey-green undertones, a restrained cool ivory spectral edge and strings. Keep overall muted and earthy. No vivid orange flame, ice shards, huge magical halos, luminous bloom or saturated teal. The lute should look carved and aged, with tactile broad brush planes and hand-painted irregular edges, not photorealistic or a shiny 3D model. Isolated transparent background, real alpha, square image, complete object visible with small breathing room. No lettering, floating musical notes, borders, people or hands.
